author: LGR
description:
Retrospective on this odd touchscreen adapter from 1994! The Keytec Magic Touch is a nifty panel that clamps onto the front of any display and turns it into a touch screen via serial. Provided you have the right display size and compatible 90s OS, of course. Although updated versions are still being sold today!
